why: Since 2025 several preprints (arXiv, Zenodo, ResearchGate, SSRN, Preprints.org) claim constructive or geometric proofs of the Yang-Mills mass gap; one (Agawa, March 2025) was later retracted. None is accepted by the Clay Mathematics Institute, and the problem's own Wikipedia article still states no proof is known, but the retraction and the volume of unverified claims mean the routing decision can't be settled without reading them.
